'''Babuza''' is a [[Formosan languages|Formosan language]] of the [[Babuza people|Babuza]] and [[Taokas people|Taokas]], [[indigenous people]]s of [[Taiwan]]. It is related to or perhaps descended from [[Favorlang language|Favorlang]], attested from the 17th century.

Babuza was once spoken along much of the western coast of Taiwan. Its two rather divergent dialects, Poavosa and the extinct Taokas, were separated by [[Papora language|Papora]] and [[Pazeh language|Pazeh]].

The first commercial publication to be written in Taokas is the picture book ''Osubalaki, Balalong Ramut'', published in 2020.<ref name=":0" />
